review_candidates.title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer ID70127
review_candidates.description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! About The Role We are looking for a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to maintain operational resilience across Azure, AWS, and GCP in a 24x7 environment. This role blends platform engineering with incident command, using Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and CSPM tools like Wiz. You will lead major-incident calls, own remediation follow-through, and build the playbooks that guide response. What You Will Do Scale and maintain the ability to drive operational stability across multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP). Engineer unified security policies and configuration baselines using IaC (Terraform) to prevent misconfigurations. Design, maintain, and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines to support continuous ASPM ingestion and deployment. Act on continuous monitoring alerts, utilizing Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tools like Wiz to secure workloads. Serve as Incident Commander on major and critical incidents — running the bridge, directing technical workstreams, making time-critical decisions, and coordinating cross-functional responders under pressure. Own the post-incident loop — track remediation items to closure, hold owning teams accountable to timelines, and drive systemic fixes and preventative actions across groups. Draft and send clear, accurate, audience-appropriate incident notifications and status updates to technical teams, management, and stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. Develop, maintain, and socialize divisional / group-level incident-management playbooks, runbooks, and escalation procedures that standardize response and reduce time-to-resolution. MUST HAVES You must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the US (e.g., Green card holders, TN visa holders, GC EAD, H4 EAD, U4U with EAD), as we are unable to sponsor or take over employment visa sponsorship at this time; 5+ years of experience. In-depth architectural expertise in multi-cloud defense, federated IAM, and zero-trust principles. Strong practical experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD orchestration, and Python/Go scripting. Senior-level, hands-on incident-command experience driving major/critical incident calls to resolution in a 24x7 production environment. Proven track record of remediation follow-up — coordinating with teams and holding owners accountable until issues are fully closed. Demonstrated skill drafting and issuing incident notification communications to both technical and executive audiences. Direct experience authoring divisional/group incident-management playbooks and escalation procedures. Fully autonomous. Drives the architecture of complex automated runbooks and mentors Middle-level SREs. Extensive experience deploying and tuning APIs from modern CNAPP/CSPM platforms, ideally Wiz. Prior experience building platforms subject to strict financial compliance standards (PCI-DSS, SOC2). Upper-intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES PagerDuty — hands-on experience with on-call scheduling, alert routing, and incident orchestration. ServiceNow — familiarity with incident, problem, and change management workflows and reporting. Perks And Benefits Growth without limits: build your skills through mentorship, internal TechTalks, challenging projects, and a dedicated annual learning budget Competitive compensation: get recognition that reflects your skills and impact, with regular performance and compensation reviews Flexibility: work 100% remotely with flexible hours that support focus, autonomy, and a healthy work rhythm Meaningful, modern projects: build impactful products using modern technologies alongside global teams and leading brands Collaborative culture: join a supportive environment with zero micromanagement where ideas are welcomed and contributions are recognized Well-being & support: access local well-being programs and people-focused support tailored to your location

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1）负责舱驾一体平台中间件的设计、核心模块开发与持续迭代 2）基于SOME/IP、DDS等协议，设计并实现座舱域与智驾域之间高并发、低延迟、高可靠的跨域通信机制与数据路由策略。 3）针对多核SoC及MCU架构，负责进程/线程调度、内存池管理及零拷贝（Zero-Copy）共享内存机制的开发，确保高负载状态下的系统实时性与确定性； 4）配合底层系统，实现跨操作系统（Linux/QNX/Android）的进程间通信（IPC）、共享内存管理及算力/内存资源的动态分配与隔离。 5）负责中间件的性能剖析与调优，解决多域融合场景下的通信延迟、内存泄漏、系统卡顿等疑难问题，保障系统稳定运行。 6）制定中间件接口规范（IDL），开发配套的自动化代码生成工具、调试工具及测试框架，提升跨团队协同开发效率。 7）进行车云协同、AI Agent跨域调用、大模型上车等行业前沿预研，探索中间件在大模型推理、多模态交互等场景下的技术赋能。 岗位要求： 1）计算机、电子工程、自动化等相关专业本科及以上学历，3年以上车载中间件或相似软件开发经验，有完整的舱驾一体/中央计算平台量产项目经验者优先。 2）精通C/C++，具备扎实的数据结构、算法及多线程/多进程编程功底；深入理解Linux/QNX/Android等至少一种车载操作系统的内核机制、驱动模型及IPC原理。 3）深刻理解SOA架构理念；熟练掌握SOME/IP、DDS、MQTT等车载通信协议的原理、QoS配置及性能调优；熟悉AUTOSAR CP/AP规范者优先。 4）熟悉Hypervisor（如QNX Hypervisor、ACRN等）或容器化技术，了解多OS共存环境下的安全隔离与资源共享机制。 5）熟练使用CMake、Bazel等构建工具，精通Git工作流；具备优秀的系统级性能分析能力，熟练使用perf、gprof、VTune等工具定位瓶颈。 【加分项】 1）有高通SA8155/8295/8775、英伟达Orin/Thor等主流高算力SoC平台的实际开发与量产经验。 2）熟悉ISO 26262功能安全标准，有中间件层面的安全机制（如E2E保护、看门狗、冗余管理）设计经验。 3）解ROS2、CyberRT、eCAL等开源中间件框架，或有相关代码贡献。 4）深入理解 LLM Agent 技术体系，熟练掌握 ReAct、Function Calling、Memory、Planning 等范式； 有Prompt 编写、复杂任务编排、多智能体协作或长程记忆系统构建等AI 辅助开发经验者优先

review_candidates.title: [한화에어로스페이스] 해양솔루션사업 R&D 인재풀
review_candidates.description: 한화에어로스페이스는 대한민국을 대표하는 방산∙항공∙우주 전문 기업으로, 지난 40여 년간 축적된 기술력과 사업 경험을 바탕으로 지속적인 혁신과 글로벌 성장을 이어가고 있습니다. 특히 당사는 스마트십 및 디지털 기반 해양솔루션 역량을 강화하고자 합니다. 선박용 AI 솔루션, 디지털 플랫폼, 제어시스템, 상태진단, 운항 최적화 등 차세대 핵심 기술을 통해 선박 운항의 효율성과 안전성을 높이고, 미래 해양 산업의 친환경·디지털 전환을 함께 이끌어갈 전문가를 적극적으로 찾고 있습니다. 지원해 주신 서류는 추후 채용팀에서 면밀히 검토 후, 전문성과 경험에 적합한 포지션을 제안드릴 예정이오니 많은 관심과 지원 부탁드립니다. 🚢 담대한 도전을 함께할 Great Challenger를 찾습니다! 모집분야 스마트십 개발 1.시스템 통합 • 선박 운항·관제 환경에 특화된 AI 솔루션 및 LLM 기반 서비스 개발 • AI 기반 이상감지·고장예측·운항 성능 추정·경로 최적화 알고리즘 개발 및 운영 • 시스템과 AI 모델 간 연동 및 성능 검증 수행 2.데이터 아키텍트 • 조선·해운 분야 운항 데이터, 정비 이력, 기상·항로 정보 등을 수집·정제 및 국제 표준 기반 데이터셋 구축 • LLM 학습용 데이터 품질 검증, 메타데이터 관리 및 도메인 기반 온톨로지 개발 업무 수행 3.시스템 아키텍처 • 선박용 디지털솔루션 및 Runtime 시스템 아키텍처 설계·개발 • Linux 기반 시스템 프로그램 개발, 이중화 기능 설계, 리소스 분석 및 시스템 최적화 수행 4.산업용 통신 / 네트워크 프로토콜 • 선박 제어 및 디지털솔루션 환경에 필요한 산업용 통신 인터페이스 설계·개발 • Ethernet 및 Fieldbus 기반 실시간 통신 시스템 구현과 프로토콜 연동 업무 수행 5.선박용 제어시스템 개발 및 품질관리 • 선박 제어용 Runtime, Logic, Library 및 자동화 시스템 개발 • IEC 61131-3 기반 편집 기능 및 제어 솔루션 설계·구현, 커미셔닝 지원 업무 수행 • 선박 관제 대시보드 및 응용 소프트웨어 UI/UX 설계·개발 • 사용자 요구사항을 반영한 기능 개선 및 운영 시스템 인터페이스 고도화 수행 • H/W·S/W 품질 검사, 표준화 문서 관리 및 품질경영시스템 운영 담당 차세대 추진 솔루션 개발 1.CAE(Computer Aided Engineering) • Cranktrain, Valve Train 및 주요 엔진 부품에 대한 구조·동역학·진동 해석 수행 • CAE 기반 시뮬레이션을 활용한 설계 검증 및 개선안 도출 • 냉각, 연료 분사(FIE), 연소 및 열유동 특성에 대한 CFD 기반 해석 수행 • 성능·배출가스·열관리 최적화를 위한 해석 및 개선안 도출 2.시험 • 엔진 및 주요 부품의 성능·내구·신뢰성 평가 수행 • 반복 하중, 진동, 운전 조건 변화에 따른 시험 데이터 분석 및 검증 • 시험 결과 기반 기술 이슈 분석 및 설계 개선 지원 • 연료 분사 압력·유량·분무 특성 분석 및 최적화 수행 • CAE/CFD 해석 결과와 실험 데이터 비교 검증 수행 3.제어 • 냉각·윤활 시스템의 유량, 압력, 온도 비간 성능 분석 및 제어 로직 검토 • 시스템 효율 및 신뢰성 향상을 위한 제어 전략 검토 • 연소 효율, 출력, 배출가스 특성 개선을 위한 제어 변수 분석 4.설계 • Crankshaft, Connecting Rod, Bearing 등 주요 회전체 및 구조 부품 설계 • Valve Train 구동계 및 신뢰성 향상을 위한 제어 전략 검토 • 내구성·진동·신뢰성을 고려한 엔진 구조 설계 수행 • 유량·압력·온도 기반 시스템 설계 및 성능 개선 지원 공통 자격 요건 • 모집 분야별 유관 전공, 경력 및 전문 역량 보유자 지원방법 • 자유 양식의 이력서로 링크드인 간편 지원을 해주시길 바랍니다. • 서류전형에 합격하신 경우 면접 진행 시 자세한 정보 확인을 위해 추가 경력기술서 제출 등을 요청드릴 수 있습니다. 채용절차 • 서류 전형 > 1차 면접 > 2차 면접 > 신원조회 > 평판조회 > 처우협의·채용검진 > 입사 • 지원하시는 포지션의 특성과 역할에 따라 일부 전형 단계가 추가되거나 조정될 수 있습니다. 세부 전형 절차는 각 포지션에 맞춰 진행되고 있으며, 이에 대한 안내는 개별적으로 드릴 예정입니다.

review_candidates.title: Service Desk Specialist II - ST
review_candidates.description: The Service Desk Specialist II has the primary responsivities for receipt, triage, and resolution of Service Requests and Incidents related to computer systems, hardware, or software to clients over the phone, online, or in person. They are responsible for resolving escalated issues, supporting the Service Desk Specialist I, and identifying ways to improve the overall Client Experience provided by the Service Desk. The Service Desk Specialist II must utilize excellent customer service, problem solving, and technical reasoning skills. They also must multitask and organize their work effectively to meet their daily, weekly, and monthly goals. What you will do here: Provide support to end users on a variety of technology issues in person, over the phone, through email, and online chat; both locally and remotely troubleshoot using diagnostic tools and techniques to resolve technical issues within required service levels. Take ownership of service requests and incident identification through to resolution. Prioritize and schedule support; accurately log all Service Desk tickets using the defined tracking software. Perform hands-on fixes at the desktop level, including installing and upgrading software, installing hardware, configuring systems and applications, research and testing of system upgrades using Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager. Image and deploying all PCs and Laptops Set-up new employee profiles, including hardware, software, network access and security. Both locally and remotely create/disable/delete user accounts upon hire or termination. Set-up new or replacement equipment, monitors, and input/output devices. Adjust, repair, and replace malfunctioning equipment. Support the process of deploying iPhones for employees, resolve iOS and mobile device issues - work with vendors to order equipment. Update/maintain IT inventory and assist with audit log of issued and shelved IT equipment, software, and other IT assets. Performs routine hardware and software testing. Perform user maintenance in Active Directory and vendor applications. Oversee network and server monitoring systems to ensure reliable service levels and avoid service outages. Evaluate and analyze trends on documented resolutions and make recommendations for ways to prevent future issues. Review, validate, update and create Knowledge Articles to facilitate accurate and robust knowledge sharing. Train new technicians on procedures and expectations. Perform other duties as assigned. What you will need: High School Diploma or GED required. Associate degree in an IT related major preferred. Bachelor's degree in an IT related major preferred. 3+ years experience in a Help Desk environment supporting internal and/or external clients preferred. 1+ years experience Fin Services experience preferred. Competency through experience with the following technologies: Windows Servers, Active Directory, Exchange, System Center, SharePoint required. Basic knowledge of: Storage Area Networks, Databases, Programming Languages, Server Virtualization required. Must be able to effectively manage time by analyzing workload, assigning priorities, and maintaining focus on productive endeavor.to meet their daily, weekly, and monthly goals required. Excellent Written And Verbal Communication Skills Required. Excellent customer service, problem solving, and technical reasoning skills required. Microsoft Certification preferred. HDI Certification preferred. CompTIA A+ Certification preferred. We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing. For additional information about our organization, careers, and benefits visit: http://www.desertfinancial.com/careers.
